: ''This article is about the island itself. For the human kingdom, see [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)]]. For the in-game reputation faction, see [[Kul Tiras (faction)]].''
'''Kul Tiras''' (also spelled '''Kul'Tiras'''<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|29|Lightforge Iron (quest)|Lightforge Iron}}</ref>, pronounced KOOL-teer-AHS)<ref>''Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness'' and ''Beyond the Dark Portal'' mission briefings. See http://www.youtube.com/watch?&v=hTjGagw64KI</ref> is a large island off [[Khaz Modan]]'s west coast, within the [[Baradin Bay]]. It sits between [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]] and [[Lordaeron]]. The island is home to [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|the human nation]] of the same name.
